thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a compliance dry-run (threat model walkthrough + access recert pre-check) ahead of the Q2 audit. Proposing two slots: Tue 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 15:00–16:00 PT. Pre-read doc here: https://go.redwood/privsec-dryrun (please add notes). Reply with availability and volunteer to own agenda items.

ajay: Tue works for me. Happy to own infra access inventory + RBAC RFC review.

priya: Wed preferred but I can do Tue. I can take the privacy checklist and vendor access mapping.

maria: noted — Ajay infra, Priya privacy/vendor. @tomas can you own service-account and machine identity list?

tomas: I can. Will export service account list from IAM and add a short blurb to the doc. Need ~2hrs to pull and sanity-check.

security-bot: Reminder: attach previous audit artifacts to the doc if you reference them — /attach audit-2024.zip

maria: Draft agenda (added to doc as well):
```
1) Quick intros & scope (5m)
2) Threat model walkthrough (20m) — focus on token flows + data stores
3) Access inventory review (15m) — infra/service accounts/RBAC
4) Vendor & third-party access (10m)
5) RFC/controls gap discussion (10m)
6) Action items & owners (5m)
```

priya: :eyes: can we add a short SRE incident access example under threat model? useful for auditors.

ajay: good call — adding a sample runbook snippet. also note: RBAC RFC PR #482 needs a quick review; maybe slot 5a.

maria: added RBAC RFC review as 5a. Pre-read assignments: Ajay — infra inventory + RBAC PR link, Tomas — service accounts export, Priya — privacy/vendor checklist. Please add anything you want us to call out in the doc.

tomas: done — uploaded / attachments: sa-list.csv and notes. Quick Q: include vendor accounts for monitoring (Datadog/LogDNA)?

priya: yes include monitoring vendors + SSO roles. I'll flag dataflow mapping for them.

maria: one more ask — legal sign-off for sharing snippets of logs in the meeting. @sophie-legal can you confirm if redaction is required before we show examples?

sophie-legal: I can review the pre-read and confirm. If logs contain PII we need redaction; but infra metadata samples are fine. Will aim to finish review by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: vote: Tue :thumbsup: (preferred)

priya: vote: Wed :thumbsup: (slightly prefer)

maria: polling quick count: Tue=1, Wed=1. If no more objections I'll schedule Tue to keep things moving — otherwise I'll follow up with Doodle.

calendar-bot: Tentative event created for Tue 10:00–11:00 PT (pending RSVPs) — https://calendar.redwood/ev/1802507890

maria: Thanks all — final ask: if you can't make your pre-read owner tasks, comment in the doc so we can reassign. I’ll send final invite by tomorrow 10:00 PT. :calendar:
